query: SELECT DISTINCT n.session_id FROM agent_session_notification n JOIN agent_session s ON s.id = n.session_id WHERE n.delivered_at IS NULL AND (n.wake OR n.action_id IS NOT NULL) AND (n.lease_until IS NULL OR n.lease_until < now()) AND s.archived_by IS NULL AND ($1::uuid IS NULL OR n.session_id > $1) ORDER BY n.session_id LIMIT 100
